name: Garakuta Mana
source:
[b]Cheerful and outgoing gyaru who loves club activities[/b]

A high-energy girl who’s all about her club and not so great at studying. She’s cheerful, super sociable, and has tons of friends.

While academics aren’t her strong point, she has an amazing memory for faces and names. She’s a member of the swimming team, and to make it easy to jump straight into practice, she usually wears her swimsuit under a tracksuit.

She’s close friends with Suzu—they’re both in the same remedial classes and also work part-time together. They often hang out, go on little outings, or visit each other’s homes. The two are practically inseparable.

Fun fact: her mom used to be a cosplayer.


•Her birthday it's the same day as the "World Friendship Day"
•She is good at: Sports, instant memory (only for things she's interested in).
•She is bad at: Studying.

[i]"Hey hey! Heading home? Let's go together then! ♪"[/i]
